# Known-failing test files (see TECHNICAL_DOSSIER.md Appendix G).
# CI fails only if a file NOT on this list fails — remove lines as they get fixed.
#
# 2026-07-27: cut from 11 files to 1. Seven were genuinely failing and are now
# fixed (denizen-mesh-capabilities, discord-integration-security, jelly,
# local-harness-loop, npc-brains, npc-local-metrics, room-generator). Four more
# — chat-attachments, dossier-system, health-runbook and generate-city-endpoint
# — had started passing but were still listed, leaving the gate looser than the
# suite required.
#
# generate-city-endpoint is NOT an assertion failure: all five of its tests
# pass. It boots a real server as a child process and the test process then
# fails to exit, so run-tests.mjs kills it at the 30s per-file timeout and
# counts that as a failure (dossier defect G#36). It is intermittent — under
# the harness it sometimes exits cleanly in ~5s. Active handles at exit are the
# child's stdio pipes, the ChildProcess itself, and an undici keep-alive socket
# to the server. Releasing all three did not demonstrably help, so that attempt
# was reverted rather than shipped unverified.
tests/generate-city-endpoint.test.js
